liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Passenger** (2 reviews): Passenger sizzles, with notable slide playing from Jerry; Reviewer lived and loved Passenger, and found the band a little tired from the previous week's shows [4][14]
- **Brown Eyed Women** (1 review): Jerry's breaks are phenomenal and the tone is right; reviewer's favorite of the tape [6]
- **Althea** (1 review): Very subtle Althea that grows on you with repeated listens [10]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): The jam is jazzy and hot, as the reviewer remembers and the tape confirms [4]
- **Deal** (1 review): Let It Grow into Deal is hot and stomping, with Bobby wailing [5]
- **Ship Of Fools** (1 review): Good pace and solos, with Brent strongly present in the harmonies [6]
- **Drums** (1 review): Drums are short but trippy [5]

## The recordings

- **gd80-08-24.naks-eaton.jim.10531.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 158 min; rated 4.47/5 by 17 [1]. Said about its sound: Very nice sounding audience recording despite the half empty hall; Reviewer calls the sound quality superb [9][10]
- **gd1980-08-24.128391.naks.mason.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 152 min; rated 3.38/5 by 8 [2]

## Around the show

- Taper recorded from the balcony, away from most rowdy crowd noise, though audience is loud at band's entrance and between songs [3]
- Reviewer attended; says the auditorium was half empty [4]
- Reviewer finds it notable that the Dead played this show in Grand Rapids, Michigan [8]
- Reviewer estimates only one to two thousand attended in a small, half empty auditorium [9]
- Reviewer was born during this show, around 10:30 PM, about 90 miles away [12]
- Attendee stood within five feet of the stage in general admission, in front of Brent's side [13]
- A balcony audience member can be heard shouting a warning just before Samson and Delilah [13]
- Attendees drove from Wisconsin, bought tickets at the box office on arrival; summer evening, small room [14]
- China Cat into Rider is called the best of 1980 so far, with Rochester shortly after [5]
- China Cat into Rider could be among the best of 1980; reviewer calls the show a sleeper of 1980 [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd80-08-24.naks-eaton.jim.10531.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Rob Eaton; source: Audience Recording: Nak 300 [1]
- **gd1980-08-24.128391.naks.mason.flac16**: taped by Mason B. Taylor; source: Recorded By Mason Taylor on a Nakamichi 550 Cassette Deck, on chrome tapes, with Nakamichi microphones [2]. Also: Taped by Mason B. Taylor, Chicago taper, who used a Nakamichi 550 with Nakamichi 300 shotgun mics early on [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Herb Greene: [Grateful Dead Grand Rapids MI 1980 Concert Poster](https://concertposterauction.com/Listing/Details/267269/Grateful-Dead-Grand-Rapids-MI-1980-Concert-Poster) [16]
